name: The Magical Chest of the Topaz God

system.description:
A small, plain bronze chest that holds any amount of treasure, weapons, etc. (not living beings), as long as one edge, corner or protuberance fits its 6-inch square mouth. No charges.

How many exist: five or six, by legend. Never for sale, though one may sometimes be borrowed from a temple or the Imperium for a mission.
